nodes.label: AUTH_ONLINE_SECURITY_ENABLED/_PROFILE Shared Gate (Issue #587)
nodes.rationale: isFullOnlineSecurityActive(env) is the single function every online feature (#588-#592) must call before doing anything provider-related; both env vars are optional/backward-compatible so unset deployments behave identically to before the epic.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Turnstile Gate (Issue #588)
nodes.rationale: isTurnstileRequired = isFullOnlineSecurityActive AND isTurnstileEnabled; fail-closed on misconfiguration; enforceTurnstileIfRequired called from 4 endpoints before expensive DB/hashing work.

nodes.label: Turnstile Circuit Breaker Bug (PR #596 Security Review)
nodes.rationale: Original code called breaker.recordFailure() for both transport failures AND valid 2xx success:false responses; since the breaker is shared/cross-tenant and enforceTurnstileIfRequired fails closed when open, an attacker could send a handful of garbage tokens every ~30s to lock login/reset/setup for ALL tenants. Fixed by only recording genuine transport failures (5xx/parse error/network/timeout).

nodes.label: MFA/TOTP Login Challenge (Issue #589)
nodes.rationale: MFA is opt-in per identity, not tenant-mandatory even with the gate active; login pauses (401 MFA_REQUIRED with mfaChallengeToken) rather than failing; POST /auth/mfa/totp/verify is the only MFA endpoint that doesn't need a session, authenticated via possession token instead.

nodes.label: MFA Replay Prevention via Atomic Compare-and-Swap (PR #597)
nodes.rationale: verifyMfaChallenge originally did SELECT then separate UPDATE for last_used_step/used_at/failed_attempts; under READ COMMITTED, concurrent verification requests all read stale state before either commits, letting replay guards and failed_attempts limits be bypassed by parallel guessing. Fixed with SELECT...FOR UPDATE on the challenge row plus compare-and-swap UPDATEs (WHERE last_used_step < $step / WHERE used_at IS NULL) for last_used_step and recovery code.

nodes.label: Google OIDC Login (Issue #590)
nodes.rationale: Tenant id carried via OAuth state param (not header, since callback is a pure browser redirect); ID token verified cryptographically via WebCrypto RS256; account linked by stable sub, never by email unless email_verified AND domain in AUTH_GOOGLE_ALLOWED_DOMAINS (fail-closed empty list).

nodes.label: Unauthenticated FK Insert Trips Global DB Circuit Breaker (PR #598)
nodes.rationale: GET .../start originally INSERTed into awcms_micro_oidc_auth_requests with an unauthenticated tenantId before validating the tenant exists; an FK violation was caught by withTenant's catch-all and recorded against the single application-wide database circuit breaker, so 5 requests with random tenantIds from an unauthenticated attacker could open the breaker and take down the ENTIRE app for 30s repeatedly. Fixed by SELECTing tenant existence/status before any FK-bearing write, plus rate limiting.

nodes.label: Generic Tenant OIDC SSO Provider (Issue #591)
nodes.rationale: Generalizes Google's login into a tenant-configured provider model as a deliberate PARALLEL implementation reusing shared tables/policy functions, not a refactor of google-oidc.ts, so the already-tested Google flow stays untouched.

nodes.label: Break-Glass Enforcement at Policy-Save Time
nodes.rationale: saveTenantAuthPolicy re-checks break_glass_identity_ids eligibility against a fresh DB query before a policy that would disable password login or require SSO can be persisted, rejecting with 409 BREAK_GLASS_REQUIRED otherwise.

nodes.label: Admin Auth Policy UI (Issue #592, /admin/security)
nodes.rationale: Two independent gates control rendering: the deployment gate isFullOnlineSecurityActive and per-section ABAC permissions; status summary never re-derives each feature's own gate, importing config functions directly instead.

nodes.label: SSRF issuer_url Accepted-Risk Decision (Issue #603/#610/#612)
nodes.rationale: Decided NOT to add a private/loopback/metadata-endpoint IP denylist for tenant-configured issuer_url because full_online deployments legitimately need to reach enterprise on-prem IdPs via VPN/tunnel (bring-your-own-IdP pattern); mitigation is scoped to ABAC on who can configure it plus per-tenant+provider circuit breakers/negative-TTL cache/provider-count cap, not a network block.

nodes.label: Cross-Tenant Cache/Breaker Key Collision Bug (Issue #610)
nodes.rationale: generic-oidc-client.ts caches/breakers were keyed only by providerKey, which is unique per-tenant not globally; two different tenants naming a provider 'okta' shared the same cache entry, letting a malicious tenant admin register a lookalike provider pointing to an attacker server and poison another tenant's real 'okta' provider results — an SSO takeover primitive. Fixed by scoping all cache/breaker keys to ${tenantId}:${providerKey}.

nodes.label: Aggregate Rate Limit as Self-Inflicted DoS (Draft PR Correction)
nodes.rationale: An early draft added an aggregate (not per-source) rate limit keyed by tenantId:providerKey to stop IP-rotating probers; a second security review found this shared budget was itself an unauthenticated DoS vector (as few as 3 source IPs could exhaust it and lock out all legitimate tenant SSO logins), so it was removed entirely in favor of circuit breakers + negative-TTL cache which only throttle failed attempts.

nodes.label: Self-Registration Admin-Approval + Sealed Auth URLs (PR #318)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in, backward-compatible feature above the #587-#593 epic: redesigned auth screens, admin-approval self-signup, and encrypted auth URL params. Deployed to dinkes-prod 2026-07-23 dormant (flags unset).
